title: 2026-10-29_Sofacy_Fysbis_Backdoor_Investigation_3cb
description: Investigate and identify malicious activity related to the Sofacy group's Fysbis backdoor on a Linux system.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target system has exhibited unusual network activity. Your task is to investigate and identify any malicious activity related to the Sofacy group's Fysbis backdoor. The Fysbis backdoor is known to target Linux systems and can install itself with or without root privileges. It uses a rolling double-XOR algorithm to construct malware installation paths, filenames, and descriptions for a Linux root account.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox environment via the provided cloud interface.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the `target` host and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services running that might be communicating with an external command-and-control (C2) server.
levels.solution: Check the list of running services and look for any that seem out of place or have unusual configurations. The hidden flag is the name of the suspicious service.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the list of running services and look for any that seem out of place or have unusual configurations.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for the suspicious communication identified in the previous task.
levels.solution: Inspect the C2 service definitions and pay particular attention to `ExecStart`, which specifies the command launched by the service with a port number as an argument. The hidden flag is the C2 port number.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the service configuration file for the suspicious service to find the port number.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
